name.title: Agency name
name.description: Full or partial agency name to search for. Leave blank to browse by state instead.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to agencies located there, e.g. "CA".

minRating.title: Minimum star rating
minRating.description: Only return agencies with at least this CMS quality-of-care rating (1-5 stars, half-star increments). Leave blank for all rated agencies.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of agencies to return.
